channel.title: QuotePlace — Quote of the Day
channel.description: One quote, every day, chosen deterministically from the QuotePlace collection.

item.title: Oscar Wilde — Quote of the Day, 2026-10-31
item.description: “Anybody can make history. Only a great man can write it.” — Oscar Wilde

item.title: Ibn Sina — Quote of the Day, 2026-10-30
item.description: “The world is divided into men who have wit and no religion and men who have religion and no wit.” — Ibn Sina

item.title: Henry David Thoreau — Quote of the Day, 2026-10-29
item.description: “I went to the woods because I wished to live deliberately.” — Henry David Thoreau

item.title: Rene Descartes — Quote of the Day, 2026-10-28
item.description: “Divide each difficulty into as many parts as is feasible and necessary to resolve it.” — Rene Descartes

item.title: Ibn Sina — Quote of the Day, 2026-10-27
item.description: “I prefer a short life with width to a narrow one with length.” — Ibn Sina

item.title: Fyodor Dostoevsky — Quote of the Day, 2026-10-26
item.description: “Man only likes to count his troubles; he doesn't calculate his happiness.” — Fyodor Dostoevsky

item.title: Denis Waitley — Quote of the Day, 2026-10-25
item.description: “A dream is your creative vision for your life in the future. You must break out of your current comfort zone and become comfortable with the unfamiliar and the unknown.” — Denis Waitley

item.title: Ibn Arabi — Quote of the Day, 2026-10-24
item.description: “I follow the Way of Love, and where love's caravan turns along the road, that is my religion and my faith.” — Ibn Arabi
